paper.core_task: Enhancing multiturn human-LLM collaboration for tasks like document creation, code generation, and math problem solving.

contributions.name: A multiturn-aware reward estimation framework for LLM training
contributions.author_claim_text: Its key innovation is a collaborative simulation that estimates the long-term contribution of responses using Multiturn-aware Rewards.
contributions.description: A framework that uses forward sampling with a user simulator to estimate the long-term impact of model responses on conversation trajectories, enabling reinforcement fine-tuning to promote proactive, goal-aligned behavior.

contributions.name: A multiturn interaction benchmark for collaborative LLMs
contributions.author_claim_text: We also devise a multiturn interaction benchmark with three challenging tasks such as document creation.
contributions.description: A benchmark consisting of three multiturn tasks (document editing, code generation, math problem solving) created from public data to evaluate LLMs' collaborative performance in simulated environments.

novelty_claims.text:
**Summary:**
The paper introduces COLLABLLM, a novel training framework for enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs) in multiturn human-LLM collaboration.
